name: @luci-dev/mcp

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: Everything Luci knows about the project, validated: stack, goal, the project's own rules, commands, the active task, selected skills (short entries, not full text), skill packs, code map and Global Brain location, plus warnings. Call this first when starting work in a project.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: get_active_task
tools.description: The current task (.luci/local/active-task.md) while its status is active: the task, which skill files to open and why, and acceptance criteria. Call this when resuming work so the user does not have to brief you again.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: get_project_status
tools.description: Resume a project (like `luci start`): refreshes the project's summary of the user's Global Brain, then reports the checks, the active task, goal, rules and skills. Writes only the generated summary .luci/local/global-brain.md.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Detect the project from its files: framework, languages, package manager, UI libraries, testing tools, commands and which agents are set up. Reads only.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: get_project_graph
tools.description: The project's code map (Graphify): where it is, its size, and whether code changed since it was built (a stale map can miss recent code; read changed files directly). With update: true it builds or refreshes the map with Graphify if installed, writing only graphify-out/. It never installs anything; `luci map --install` does, run by the user.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

update.description: Build or refresh the map (only call after the user agrees; it can take a minute)

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the skills in the Luci library (and the user's personal library), with trust levels.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the skill library by relevance to a query.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: One skill by name: its metadata, trust level and full instructions.

tools.name: recommend_skills
tools.description: The library skills that fit a task, each with the reason it was chosen, and the order to use them in. Returns none when nothing fits. Reads only.

framework.description: Target framework, e.g. react, nextjs, vue

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: load_skills
tools.description: Full instructions of the library skills that closely match a task, within a token budget. Skills that do the same job (e.g. two animation libraries) are not loaded together: the one the project already depends on wins. Returns nothing when no skill fits.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tokenBudget.description: Max tokens of full skill instructions (default 8000)

tools.name: get_project_skills
tools.description: The skills chosen for this project (.luci/skills.lock.json and .luci/skills/): name, summary, why chosen, size and file path. Does not load full instructions.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: load_project_skills
tools.description: Full instructions of only those project skills that closely match the current task, within a token budget. Returns nothing when no project skill fits.

taskPrompt.description: The task you are about to do

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tokenBudget.description: Max tokens of full skill instructions (default 8000)

tools.name: select_project_skills
tools.description: Add library skills to the project (.luci/skills.lock.json) and refresh the skill catalog. Only call this after the user agrees to use these skills in the project.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: list_skill_packs
tools.description: Skill packs (curated skill sets): which fit this project and why, which are added, and the skills each would add here. Reads only.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: add_skill_packs
tools.description: Add skill packs to the project (their skills go to .luci/skills.lock.json, tagged with the pack). Only call this after the user agrees to add these packs.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: remove_skill_packs
tools.description: Remove skill packs from the project. Skills another pack still uses, and skills chosen by hand, stay. Only call this after the user agrees.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: update_project_memory
tools.description: Record a decision the user confirmed as a decision record in .luci/decisions/. Only for decisions the user agreed to; for a rule or lesson you would like kept, use propose_memory.

category.description: Area, e.g. Architecture, Testing, Performance, UI/UX

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: propose_memory
tools.description: Propose a rule, convention or lesson for the project. It is written to .luci/memory/proposed/ for the user to accept or delete; rules.md, context.md and playbook.md are never edited by agents.

proposed.description: The rule, convention or note to keep

belongsIn.description: Where it would go once accepted

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: intake_docs
tools.description: Fit a PRD and supporting docs (Markdown or text) into project memory, like `luci intake`: empty goal, architecture and conventions sections of context.md are filled; candidate rules, non-goals, acceptance criteria, decisions and a pointer to each doc become proposals in .luci/memory/proposed/ for the user to review. Nothing a person wrote is replaced. Only call this after the user agrees; use dryRun to show the plan first.

files.description: Doc paths, relative to the project or absolute

dryRun.description: Report what would be written; write nothing

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: initialize_project
tools.description: Set the project up with Luci: create .luci/ (memory, starter skills, skill catalog) and the Luci section of each agent's instruction file; files someone edited are kept. Only call this after the user agrees. Use dryRun to show what would be written.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

dryRun.description: Report what would be written; write nothing

tools.name: get_global_brain
tools.description: The user's Global Brain: their confirmed preferences, design principles and coding standards across all projects, by file. Creates it from the defaults the first time; never changes a file the user has.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.description: UI feedback notes the person left on their running app with Luci's dev toolbar (.luci/feedback/). By default the ones not done yet, each with its ID (P2-A3), comment, intent, priority, selector, text, source file, components and any layout steps. Reads only: the person marks notes done themselves.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: get_feedback_prompt
tools.description: The UI feedback notes not done yet as one page-grouped prompt: every note with its ID, grouped by page with route and source file, and how to report when done. Work through every page and report every ID in your answer; the person checks your work and marks notes done in their toolbar. Reads only.

detail.description: compact: selector and text; standard (default): + source file and components; detailed: + computed styles

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: watch_feedback
tools.description: Watch mode: wait while the person leaves new UI feedback notes with the dev toolbar, then return the new ones as one page-grouped prompt, as soon as there are any. Waits up to `seconds` (default 120, at most 600); when nothing comes it says so, and you call it again to keep watching. Pass `since` from the previous answer so no note is missed or repeated. Apply each batch, report its IDs, then watch again. Reads only.

seconds.description: How long to wait for new notes (default 120)

since.description: Only notes added after this time (ISO, UTC), as the previous answer gives it; default: from now

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: list_captures
tools.description: Design captures saved into this project (.luci/design/): components, text, colors, spacing, systems, whole pages and basket exports, measured from live pages, and the project's own design baseline (project.system.typography/color/spacing.design.md, method authored: the values and tokens its stylesheets already have; reuse them). Read one with get_capture before building or restyling UI it describes. Reads only.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: get_capture
tools.description: One saved design capture (a .design.md file from list_captures), as written. Use its values, tokens, states and image slots as the reference; the "Your instructions" section, when present, is the person's own request.

file.description: File name from list_captures, e.g. example-com.component.card.design.md

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: get_design_checks
tools.description: The latest design checks from the dev toolbar (v0.4, automatic design check): each built component checked against its design file, re-checked by the toolbar whenever the page changes (after your edits reload it), with every difference left. Use it after changing a component the person is checking, to see whether it now matches; when differences remain, fix them and read this again. Reads only (.luci/design/checks.json).

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: compare_captures
tools.description: Compare two saved component captures (from list_captures), part by part: parts, styles, state changes, motion and accessibility. Returns every value that differs as a table (What, A, B), values compared by meaning (any color notation, lengths within half a pixel). Reads only.

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: get_layout_tree
tools.description: Get the computed hierarchical layout tree of a saved component or section capture (from list_captures). Returns the parent/child flex and grid layout relationships, directions, alignment, and gaps as a formatted tree outline. Reads only.

file.description: A component or section capture file name, e.g. example-com.component.card.design.md

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: propose_capture_rule
tools.description: Propose a project rule from a saved component capture: one line for rules.md ("Build every primary button like .luci/design/<file>: ...") with its key values and state changes, written to .luci/memory/proposed/ for the user to accept or delete. rules.md is never edited. Only when the user asks to make a capture a rule.

file.description: A component capture from list_captures, e.g. example-com.component.primary-button.design.md

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

tools.name: crawl_site_design
tools.description: Crawl a list of routes or URLs of a site in one pass, extract typography, color and spacing systems from each page, and merge them into a unified site-level design system. Saves site systems into .luci/design/ and writes root DESIGN.md when stitch is true.

urls.description: URLs or routes to crawl, e.g. ["http://localhost:3000/", "/pricing", "/blog"]

base.description: Base URL if relative routes are given, e.g. "http://localhost:3000"

stitch.description: Write root DESIGN.md in Google Stitch format (default: true)

projectPath.description: Project folder (defaults to the folder the server was started in)

instructions: Luci keeps this project's memory and skills on the user's machine. Start with get_project_context (and get_active_task when resuming). Load skills with load_project_skills only when the task needs them. Tools that write say so; call them only after the user agrees.
